messages.content: Find me a documentary about global warming.

function.name: retrieve_scientific_paper
function.description: Fetches the details of scientific research paper based on its topic. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

year.description: Year of publishing of the research paper. If not specified, fetches the most recent paper

message.content:
Here are a few highly regarded documentaries that explore global warming and climate change:

| Title | Year | Synopsis |
|-------|------|----------|
| **“An Inconvenient Truth”** | 2006 | Former Vice‑President Al Gore presents a comprehensive overview of climate science and the urgent need for action. |
| **“An Inconvenient Sequel: Truth to Power”** | 2017 | A follow‑up that examines progress (or lack thereof) since the first film and highlights new scientific findings. |
| **“Before the Flood”** | 2016 | Leonardo DiCaprio travels the world to meet scientists, activists, and policymakers, illustrating the human impact of climate change. |
| **“Climate Change: The Facts”** | 2019 | A BBC production that debunks myths and explains the science behind global warming in an accessible way. |
| **“The 11th Hour”** | 2007 | A global perspective on environmental degradation, featuring interviews with leading scientists and activists. |
| **“Our Planet”** (Netflix series) | 2019 | While not solely about climate change, each episode shows how warming affects ecosystems worldwide. |
| **“The Day After Tomorrow”** (fictional but based on real science) | 2004 | A dramatized depiction of extreme weather events caused by rapid climate change; useful for sparking discussion. |

These films are widely available on streaming platforms such as Netflix, Amazon Prime Video, Hulu, or can be rented/bought on iTunes, Google Play, or YouTube Movies. If you’d like more specific recommendations (e.g., short documentaries, regional focus, or recent releases), just let me know!
